page.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change the buyer data rules.
page.connectionsHelp: {own} of {total} connections have their own rules. You change them in the connection edit.
page.defaultsBody: Every new connection and every connection without its own rules follows these. In a connection's edit you can change them for that connection only. They apply to OpenLinker only; the data stays in the shop and on the marketplace.
page.description: General rules for all connections. Each connection can have its own, set in the connection edit.
page.enableDialogBody: From the next night OpenLinker applies these rules to orders. Erased personal data cannot be restored. Invoices and receipts that were already issued are not changed.
page.enableDialogTitle: Turn on the buyer data rules?

page.offBody: Buyer data is kept without a time limit. Nothing changes until you turn the rules on.

period.errorAmount: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
period.errorRange: Use 0 for never, or 30 to 3650 days.

rules.eraseBeforeHide: Personal data cannot be erased before the order is hidden.
rules.eraseDescription: Counted from the day the order was placed.
rules.eraseLabel: When should personal data be erased?
rules.eraseNever: Never, data stays without a time limit
rules.hideDescription: The order leaves the list but its data stays in OpenLinker. You find it under the "Hidden" filter.
rules.hideLabel: When should an order be hidden?
rules.hideNever: Never, orders stay on the list
rules.irreversibleBody: Erased personal data cannot be restored, and syncing an order again does not bring it back. Invoices and receipts that were already issued are not changed.
rules.modeDescriptionPersonal: Name, email, phone, tax number and address are replaced with a code such as BUYER-000123. Amounts and products stay.
rules.modeDescriptionWhole: When the data is erased, the order is also hidden from the lists. Amounts and products stay in OpenLinker.
rules.summaryEraseNever: Personal data is kept without a time limit.
